verdict.rationale: Microsoft Teams' own docs show that teams can be configured with channels, that people can be added to a team, and that apps can automate creating teams, channels and conversations. This covers channel-based organization and team-level membership. Nothing in the pack documents a public versus private channel distinction or per-channel membership controls. Missing for 10: public vs private channel types, channel-level membership and permission controls, admin-facing (non-API) channel management docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: add the right people to the team, and configure the team with channels, tabs, and apps
These apps can also automate creating teams, channels, and conversations
